title: Joint petition of Neil deGuzman, Lester Grant and Robert Goodman for approval by the Masssachusetts Department of Public Utilities, pursuant to G.L. c. 159A, § 7A of the transfer from Neil deGuzman and Lester Grant ("Transferors") of all of the outstanding capital stock of Boston Doubledeckers, Inc. to Robert Goodman ("Transferee") individually and as Trustee of a Voting Trust.
